summary: Iteration 172 — What's New changelog tile + Help Center modern seed. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed (changelog entries, since, auth gate, help articles include 11 modern slugs and exclude 7 stale slugs, whats-new article body, admin reseed prune). Frontend: dashboard WhatsNewTile renders with 4 entries, '6 new' counter badge, category pills (merge/feature/feature/feature), 'View full changelog' link to /help/whats-new, and 'Mark all as seen' clears the badge and writes '2026-06-25' to nx-whats-new-seen-v1. /help/whats-new article opens with 'Latest Releases', '2026-06-25 — Big Cleanup' headings.

issues: Existing users with a pre-existing `nx-dashboard-layout-v2` localStorage entry will NOT see the new What's-New tile until they reset their layout. The tile only appears for users whose layout was rebuilt from DEFAULT_LAYOUT_LG. Consider auto-injecting the new widget when reading the persisted layout (e.g. if 'whats-new' missing from saved layout, append it at y=16) so the feature lights up automatically for everyone.

action_items: Optional: migrate existing persisted dashboard layouts to include the new 'whats-new' widget so users don't have to wipe localStorage to see it.
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsNewTile.jsx uses axios directly with manual Authorization header; project should consider centralising via an API client instance (DRY).
Changelog list lives inline in /app/backend/app/routers/changelog.py — fine for now (<200 lines) but if it grows beyond ~50 entries, move CHANGELOG to a JSON/Markdown source file.
Frontend dashboard layout persistence does not migrate when WIDGET_META adds new widgets — minor UX gap that affects every future widget release.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (tile + counter + mark-seen + view-all + /help/whats-new article all verified)

seed_data_creation: None — changelog is static; /api/help/seed was exercised during the reseed test which idempotently upserts the 13 modern articles and prunes stale slugs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Changelog endpoints (/api/changelog/entries, /api/changelog/since) live in /app/backend/app/routers/changelog.py with 6 static CHANGELOG entries. Help articles are seeded from /app/backend/app/routers/_help_seed_modern.py with 13 MODERN_ARTICLES and a STALE_SLUGS prune list. POST /api/help/seed response shape: {seeded, modern_seeded, pruned}. Frontend tile testids: whats-new-tile (root), whats-new-counter (badge, only when entries newer than nx-whats-new-seen-v1), whats-new-mark-seen (button), whats-new-view-all (link to /help/whats-new), whats-new-entry-{id} (per entry), whats-new-link-{id} (primary deep-link). Dashboard tile lives at grid y=16; to verify on existing accounts you must clear localStorage key 'nx-dashboard-layout-v2'. Verified that mark-seen writes '2026-06-25' (newest entry date) to localStorage and hides the badge.
